mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does custom stonework require?

acceptedAnswer.text: The maintenance requirements for custom stonework vary by stone type and its application. Generally, natural stone is durable and low-maintenance. Regular cleaning with mild soap and water is usually sufficient to remove dirt and debris. Sealing is often recommended, especially for porous stones or high-traffic areas like patios and outdoor kitchen countertops, to protect against stains and moisture. Re-sealing frequency depends on the stone type and exposure. We provide specific care instructions for your chosen materials upon project completion to ensure longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance typically involves regular cleaning with mild soap and water. Sealing is often recommended for protection, with frequency depending on stone type and use.
